verdict.rationale: Flagsmith Experimentation documents collecting events from your application into a managed data warehouse and reading results with a built-in Bayesian engine, so it covers the ingested-events path. The docs never describe how a PM defines metrics from those events. Nothing shows connecting your own warehouse tables, and the warehouse is Flagsmith-managed rather than customer-owned. Missing for 10: documented metric-definition workflow, support for customer-owned warehouse tables, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can define experiment metrics from my own data — warehouse tables or ingested events — instead of a black-box metric store

citations.quote: Flagsmith Experimentation lets you run A/B tests end to end on the platform: serve variations of a feature with a multivariate flag, collect events from your application into a managed data warehouse, and read the results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine.
